role_brief_history.lead-dev: Elian Doran founded TriliumNext in 2024, a community fork created after Zadam stepped back from the project. Zadam later transferred the original repository to the TriliumNext team, merging both projects back into one.
role_brief_history.original-dev: On 25th December 2017, Zadam released the first beta of Trilium (written with a single "l", unlike the flower). Dissatisfied with existing note organizers, he built a powerful self-hosted hierarchical knowledge base that gathered over 22,000 GitHub stars. In 2024, as life got busier, he placed the project into maintenance mode.

attribute_detail.inheritable_title: Applies to this note and to everything below it in the tree.
attribute_detail.label: Label
attribute_detail.disable_versioning: Disables auto-versioning. Useful for e.g. large, but unimportant notes - e.g. large JS libraries used for scripting.
attribute_detail.calendar_root: Marks note which should be used as root for day notes. Only one should be marked as such.
attribute_detail.archived: Notes with this label won't be visible by default in search results (also in Jump To, Add Link dialogs etc).
attribute_detail.exclude_from_export: Notes (with their sub-tree) won't be included in any note export.
attribute_detail.run:
Defines on which events script should run. Possible values are:
  • frontendStartup - when Trilium frontend starts up (or is refreshed), but not on mobile.
  • mobileStartup - when Trilium frontend starts up (or is refreshed), on mobile.
  • backendStartup - when Trilium backend starts up.
  • hourly - run once an hour. You can use additional label runAtHour to specify at which hour.
  • daily - run once a day.
attribute_detail.run_on_instance: Define which trilium instance should run this on. Default to all instances.
attribute_detail.run_at_hour: On which hour should this run. Should be used together with #run=hourly. Can be defined multiple times for more runs during the day.
attribute_detail.disable_inclusion: Scripts with this label won't be included into parent script execution.
attribute_detail.sorted: Keeps child notes sorted by title alphabetically.
attribute_detail.sort_direction: Direction #sorted orders the child notes in: desc for descending, anything else for ascending. Ignored unless #sorted is set.
attribute_detail.sort_folders_first: Folders (notes with children) should be sorted on top.
attribute_detail.top: Keep given note on top in its parent (applies only on sorted parents).
attribute_detail.hide_promoted_attributes: Hide promoted attributes on this note.
attribute_detail.read_only: Editor is in read only mode. Works only for text and code notes.
attribute_detail.auto_read_only_disabled: Text/code notes can be set automatically into read mode when they are too large. You can disable this behavior on per-note basis by adding this label to the note.
attribute_detail.app_css: Marks CSS notes which are loaded into the Trilium application and can thus be used to modify Trilium's looks.
attribute_detail.app_theme: Marks CSS notes which are full Trilium themes and are thus available in Trilium options.
attribute_detail.app_theme_base: Set to "next", "next-light", or "next-dark" to use the corresponding TriliumNext theme (auto, light or dark) as the base for a custom theme, instead of the legacy one.
attribute_detail.css_class: Value of this label is then added as CSS class to the node representing given note in the tree. This can be useful for advanced theming. Can be used in template notes.
attribute_detail.icon_class: Value of this label is added as a CSS class to the icon on the tree which can help visually distinguish the notes in the tree. Example might be bx bx-home - icons are taken from boxicons. Can be used in template notes.
attribute_detail.page_size: Number of items per page in note listing.
attribute_detail.custom_request_handler: Serves this backend script over HTTP at /custom/ followed by this value, which is matched against the path as a regular expression. The script reads the request from api.req and writes the response to api.res, with whatever the expression captured in api.pathParams.
attribute_detail.custom_resource_provider: Serves this note's content over HTTP at /custom/ followed by this value, which is matched against the path as a regular expression. No script runs — the note is sent as it is, which is how a file such as a font or an image is given a stable URL.
attribute_detail.widget: Marks this note as a custom widget which will be added to the Trilium component tree.
attribute_detail.workspace: Marks this note as a workspace which allows easy hoisting.
attribute_detail.workspace_icon_class: Defines box icon CSS class which will be used in tab when hoisted to this note.
attribute_detail.workspace_tab_background_color: CSS color used in the note tab when hoisted to this note.
attribute_detail.workspace_template: This note will appear in the selection of available template when creating new note, but only when hoisted into a workspace containing this template.
attribute_detail.search_home: New search notes will be created as children of this note.
attribute_detail.workspace_search_home: New search notes will be created as children of this note when hoisted to some ancestor of this workspace note.
attribute_detail.inbox: Default inbox location for new notes - when you create a note using "new note" button in the sidebar, notes will be created as child notes in the note marked as with #inbox label.
attribute_detail.workspace_inbox: Default inbox location for new notes when hoisted to some ancestor of this workspace note.
attribute_detail.sql_console_home: Default location of SQL console notes.
attribute_detail.bookmark_folder: Note with this label will appear in bookmarks as folder (allowing access to its children).
attribute_detail.share_hidden_from_tree: This note is hidden from left navigation tree, but still accessible with its URL.
attribute_detail.share_external_link: Note will act as a link to an external website in the share tree.
attribute_detail.share_alias: Define an alias using which the note will be available under https://your_trilium_host/share/[your_alias].
attribute_detail.share_omit_default_css: Default share page CSS will be omitted. Use when you make extensive styling changes.
attribute_detail.share_root: Marks note which is served on /share root.
attribute_detail.share_description: Define text to be added to the HTML meta tag for description.
attribute_detail.share_raw: Note will be served in its raw format, without HTML wrapper.
attribute_detail.share_disallow_robot_indexing: Will forbid robot indexing of this note via X-Robots-Tag: noindex header.
attribute_detail.share_credentials: Require credentials to access this shared note. Value is expected to be in format 'username:password'. Don't forget to make this inheritable to apply to child-notes/images.
attribute_detail.share_index: Note with this label will list all roots of shared notes.
attribute_detail.display_relations: Comma delimited names of relations which should be displayed. All other ones will be hidden.
attribute_detail.hide_relations: Comma delimited names of relations which should be hidden. All other ones will be displayed.
attribute_detail.title_template:
Default title of notes created as children of this note. The value is evaluated as JavaScript string and thus can be enriched with dynamic content via the injected now and parentNote variables. Examples:
  • ${parentNote.getLabelValue('authorName')}'s literary works
  • Log for ${now.format('YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss')}
See wiki with details, API docs for parentNote and now for details.
attribute_detail.template: This note will appear in the selection of available template when creating new note.
attribute_detail.toc: #toc or #toc=show will force the Table of Contents to be shown, #toc=hide will force hiding it. If the label doesn't exist, the global setting is observed.
attribute_detail.color: Defines color of the note in note tree, links etc. Use any valid CSS color value like 'red' or #a13d5f.
attribute_detail.keyboard_shortcut: Defines a keyboard shortcut which will immediately jump to this note. Example: 'ctrl+alt+e'. Requires frontend reload for the change to take effect.
attribute_detail.keep_current_hoisting: Opening this link won't change hoisting even if the note is not displayable in the current hoisted subtree.
attribute_detail.execute_button: Title of the button which will execute the current code note.
attribute_detail.execute_description: Longer description of the current code note displayed together with the execute button.
attribute_detail.exclude_from_note_map: Notes with this label will be hidden from the Note Map.
attribute_detail.new_notes_on_top: New notes will be created at the top of the parent note, not on the bottom.
attribute_detail.hide_highlight_widget: Hides the Highlights List for this note, leaving it shown on every other.
attribute_detail.run_on_note_creation: Executes when note is created on backend. Use this relation if you want to run the script for all notes created under a specific subtree. In that case, create it on the subtree root note and make it inheritable. A new note created within the subtree (any depth) will trigger the script.
attribute_detail.run_on_child_note_creation: Executes when new note is created under the note where this relation is defined.
attribute_detail.run_on_note_title_change: Executes when note title is changed (includes note creation as well).
attribute_detail.run_on_note_content_change: Executes when note content is changed (includes note creation as well).
attribute_detail.run_on_note_change: Executes when note is changed (includes note creation as well). Does not include content changes.
attribute_detail.run_on_note_deletion: Executes when note is being deleted.
attribute_detail.run_on_branch_creation: Executes when a branch is created. Branch is a link between parent note and child note and is created e.g. when cloning or moving note.
attribute_detail.run_on_branch_change: Executes when a branch is updated.
attribute_detail.run_on_branch_deletion: Executes when a branch is deleted. Branch is a link between parent note and child note and is deleted e.g. when moving note (old branch/link is deleted).
attribute_detail.run_on_attribute_creation: Executes when new attribute is created for the note which defines this relation.
attribute_detail.run_on_attribute_change: Executes when the attribute is changed of a note which defines this relation. This is triggered also when the attribute is deleted.
attribute_detail.relation_template: Note's attributes will be inherited even without a parent-child relationship, note's content and subtree will be added to instance notes if empty. See documentation for details.
attribute_detail.inherit: Note's attributes will be inherited even without a parent-child relationship. See template relation for a similar concept. See attribute inheritance in the documentation.
attribute_detail.render_note: Notes of type "render HTML note" will be rendered using a code note (HTML or script) and it is necessary to point using this relation to which note should be rendered.
attribute_detail.widget_relation: Target of this relation will be executed and rendered as a widget in the sidebar.
attribute_detail.share_css: CSS note which will be injected into the share page. CSS note must be in the shared sub-tree as well. Consider using 'share_hidden_from_tree' and 'share_omit_default_css' as well.
attribute_detail.share_js: JavaScript note which will be injected into the share page. JS note must be in the shared sub-tree as well. Consider using 'share_hidden_from_tree'.
attribute_detail.share_template: Embedded JavaScript note that will be used as the template for displaying the shared note. Falls back to the default template. Consider using 'share_hidden_from_tree'.
attribute_detail.share_favicon: Favicon note to be set in the shared page. Typically you want to set it to share root and make it inheritable. Favicon note must be in the shared sub-tree as well. Consider using 'share_hidden_from_tree'.
attribute_detail.print_landscape: When exporting to PDF, changes the orientation of the page to landscape instead of portrait.
attribute_detail.print_page_size: When exporting to PDF, changes the size of the page. Supported values: A0, A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, Legal, Letter, Tabloid, Ledger.
attribute_detail.print_scale: When exporting to PDF, changes the scale of the rendered content. Values range from 0.1 (10%) to 2 (200%), default is 1 (100%).
attribute_detail.print_margins: When exporting to PDF, sets page margins. Use default, none, minimum, or custom values as top,right,bottom,left in millimeters.
attribute_detail.versioning_limit: Limits how many revisions this note keeps, overriding the global setting.
attribute_detail.similar_notes_widget_disabled: Disables the Similar Notes ribbon tab for this note. Old layout only.
attribute_detail.llm_chat_home: New AI chats are created as children of this note.
attribute_detail.workspace_llm_chat_home: New AI chats are created as children of this note while hoisted to an ancestor of this workspace.
attribute_detail.date_pattern: Pattern for the titles of the day notes generated under this calendar root, e.g. {dateNumberPadded} - {weekDay}.
attribute_detail.week_pattern: Pattern for the titles of the week notes generated under this calendar root. Requires #enableWeekNote.
attribute_detail.month_pattern: Pattern for the titles of the month notes generated under this calendar root, e.g. {monthNumberPadded} - {month}.
attribute_detail.quarter_pattern: Pattern for the titles of the quarter notes generated under this calendar root. Requires #enableQuarterNote.
attribute_detail.year_pattern: Pattern for the titles of the year notes generated under this calendar root, e.g. {year}.
attribute_detail.enable_week_note: Generates a week note between the month and the day notes. Set on the calendar root; off by default.
attribute_detail.enable_quarter_note: Generates a quarter note between the year and the month notes. Set on the calendar root; off by default.
attribute_detail.date_note: Stamped on each generated day note with the date it stands for, as YYYY-MM-DD, so that scripts can find it.
attribute_detail.week_note: Stamped on each generated week note with the week it stands for.
attribute_detail.month_note: Stamped on each generated month note with the month it stands for, as YYYY-MM.
attribute_detail.quarter_note: Stamped on each generated quarter note with the quarter it stands for.
attribute_detail.year_note: Stamped on each generated year note with the year it stands for.
attribute_detail.view_type: Sets how the child notes of this note are shown, e.g. as a grid, a list, a table or a calendar.
attribute_detail.map_root_note_id: The note the note map is drawn from. Defaults to the special value hoisted.
attribute_detail.map_exclude_relation: Comma-delimited relation names to leave out of the note map.
attribute_detail.map_include_relation: Comma-delimited relation names to draw in the note map.
attribute_detail.sort_natural: Sorts numbers in the child notes naturally rather than alphabetically, so that 2 comes before 10. Needs #sorted.
attribute_detail.sort_locale: The language the natural sort follows, e.g. de or zh-CN. Only meaningful with #sortNatural.
attribute_detail.bottom: Keeps this note at the bottom of its parent, which applies only while the parent is sorted.
attribute_detail.full_content_width: Expands the note to the full width of the editor, ignoring the configured content width. Useful for wide tables.
attribute_detail.subtree_hidden: Hides this note's children from the tree behind a badge counting them. They stay reachable by search and by direct links.
attribute_detail.expanded: How many levels of children a list or grid opens expanded.
attribute_detail.share_external: Older spelling of #shareExternalLink, still read by the share theme.
attribute_detail.share_root_link: The address the shared page's logo links to.
attribute_detail.share_logo_width: Width of the shared page's logo, in pixels and without a unit. Defaults to 53.
attribute_detail.share_logo_height: Height of the shared page's logo, in pixels and without a unit. Defaults to 40.

attribute_detail.share_open_graph_url: Sets the og:url and twitter:url meta properties of the shared page.

attribute_detail.share_html_location: Where the HTML injected by ~shareHtml is placed, as location:position — head, body or content, with start or end. Set on the snippet note itself.
attribute_detail.snippet: Offers this code note as a snippet to insert into other code notes.
attribute_detail.snippet_description: Description shown beside this code snippet where it is offered for insertion.
attribute_detail.text_snippet: Offers this text note as a snippet to insert into other text notes.
attribute_detail.text_snippet_description: Description shown beside this text snippet where it is offered for insertion.
attribute_detail.execute_title: Title of the tab this code note is executed from.
attribute_detail.clipper_inbox: Where the Web Clipper saves what it collects, instead of the day note.
attribute_detail.clip_type: Records how the Web Clipper made this note, e.g. clippings.
attribute_detail.sent_from_sender: Marks a note as having arrived through the sender rather than having been written in Trilium.
attribute_detail.hide_children_overview: Hides the list of child notes shown under this note's content.
attribute_detail.media_notes_play_mode: What the media player does when a track ends, e.g. next to carry on with the following note.
attribute_detail.collection: Marks this template as a collection, so that it is offered under Collections when a note is created.
attribute_detail.web_view_src: The address a Web View note loads.
attribute_detail.icon_pack: Identifies a custom icon pack by the prefix its icons are named with.
attribute_detail.doc_name: Identifies the in-app help document this note holds. Used internally.
attribute_detail.doc_url: Address of the online documentation this help note corresponds to. Used internally.
attribute_detail.language: The language this note's content is written in, which drives spell checking and text direction.
attribute_detail.original_file_name: The name the file had when it was imported, kept so that it can be exported under it again.
attribute_detail.page_url: The address a clipped page came from, shown beside the note title.
attribute_detail.command: Which built-in command a launcher runs when it is pressed.
attribute_detail.display_mode: Which pane a split editor shows: source, preview, or split for both. Overrides what #readOnly would otherwise choose.
attribute_detail.search_string: The query a saved search runs.
attribute_detail.ancestor_depth: How far below the ~ancestor note a result may sit, e.g. eq5 for exactly five levels down.
attribute_detail.order_by: What the results of a saved search are ordered by, e.g. relevancy or the name of a label.
attribute_detail.order_direction: Which way the results of a saved search are ordered: asc or desc.
attribute_detail.limit: The greatest number of results a saved search returns.
attribute_detail.fast_search: Searches titles and attributes only, leaving note content out. Much quicker over a large database.
attribute_detail.include_archived_notes: Includes archived notes in the results of a saved search, which are otherwise left out.
attribute_detail.debug: Records how the query was understood, for working out why a saved search matches what it does.
attribute_detail.launcher_type: What a launcher does when pressed: note, script, command, customWidget or spacer.
attribute_detail.builtin_widget: Which built-in widget a launcher shows, e.g. spacer or bookmarks.
attribute_detail.script_in_launcher_content: Runs the launcher note's own content as the script, instead of following its ~script relation.
attribute_detail.base_size: The room a launch bar spacer takes before any spare space is shared out, in pixels.
attribute_detail.growth_factor: How much of the launch bar's spare room this spacer takes, against the other spacers.
attribute_detail.desktop_only: Shows this launcher only on a desktop-sized screen.
attribute_detail.electron_only: Shows this only in the desktop application, not when Trilium is reached through a browser.
attribute_detail.server_only: Shows this only when Trilium is reached through a browser, not in the desktop application.
attribute_detail.beta: Marks this template as a beta feature where it is offered in the note creation menu.
attribute_detail.one_note_page_id: The identifier the page had in OneNote, kept on import so that it can be traced back. Trilium itself does not read it.
attribute_detail.one_note_section_id: The identifier the section had in OneNote, kept on import so that it can be traced back.
attribute_detail.one_note_import_failed: Marks a note that could not be imported from OneNote, so that the failures can be searched for.
attribute_detail.status: Which column of a board this note sits in. The label a board groups by unless told otherwise.
attribute_detail.board_group_by: Which label a board groups its columns by, instead of #status.
attribute_detail.state_id: The value a task state is stored as, which is what a note carries to be in that state.
attribute_detail.markdown_symbol: The character a task state is written as in a Markdown task list, e.g. x for a completed one.
attribute_detail.is_completed: Marks a task state as meaning the task is finished.
attribute_detail.is_hidden: Keeps a task state out of the pickers, without deleting it or the notes already in it.
attribute_detail.max_nesting_depth: How many levels of children a table shows. Notes cannot be reordered while it is set.
attribute_detail.include_archived: Includes archived notes in this collection, which are otherwise left out.
attribute_detail.calendar_view: Which view a calendar opens in: timeGridDay, timeGridWeek, dayGridMonth, multiMonthYear or listMonth.
attribute_detail.calendar_initial_date: The date a calendar opens on. Opens on today when unset.
attribute_detail.calendar_hide_weekends: Hides Saturday and Sunday from the calendar. Applies whatever its value.
attribute_detail.calendar_week_numbers: Shows the number of the week on the calendar. Applies whatever its value.
attribute_detail.calendar_slot_duration: How long each timeslot of a calendar lasts, as HH:MM:SS. Defaults to 15 minutes.
attribute_detail.calendar_slot_label_interval: How often the timeslots of a calendar are labelled, as HH:MM:SS. Defaults to an hour.
attribute_detail.calendar_title: Names the attribute an event takes its title from, instead of the note title. Either a label or a relation, written without # or ~.
attribute_detail.calendar_displayed_attributes: Comma-delimited attribute names whose values are shown on the event. A relation is shown as the title of the note it points at.
attribute_detail.calendar_start_date: Names the label an event reads its start date from, instead of #startDate. Written without the #.
attribute_detail.calendar_end_date: Names the label an event reads its end date from, instead of #endDate.
attribute_detail.calendar_start_time: Names the label an event reads its start time from, instead of #startTime.
attribute_detail.calendar_end_time: Names the label an event reads its end time from, instead of #endTime.
attribute_detail.calendar_recurrence: Names the label an event reads its recurrence rule from, instead of #recurrence.
attribute_detail.start_date: The date an event starts on, as YYYY-MM-DD, which is what places it in a calendar.
attribute_detail.end_date: The date an event ends on, for one spanning several days. The end day is included.
attribute_detail.start_time: The time an event starts at, as HH:MM in 24-hour form. Without it the event lasts the whole day.
attribute_detail.end_time: The time an event ends at, read against #endDate where there is one and #startDate otherwise.
attribute_detail.recurrence: A CalDAV RRULE string making the event repeat. The start is taken from #startDate and #startTime, so the rule leaves DTSTART out.
attribute_detail.geolocation: The latitude and longitude the note is placed at on a geo map.
attribute_detail.map_type: Which note map is drawn: link for the relations between notes, or tree for the hierarchy.
attribute_detail.map_style: Which style a geo map is drawn in, chosen from the raster and vector styles offered in the collection properties.
attribute_detail.map_dark_style: Tells a geo map that the custom style given in map:style is a dark one, so that the marker titles are drawn light over it. The styles offered in the collection properties say so for themselves and need no such label.
attribute_detail.map_scale: Shows a scale bar on the geo map.
attribute_detail.map_hide_labels: Hides the note titles beside the markers on a geo map.
attribute_detail.map_cluster: Gathers markers that are drawn close together into a single numbered bubble, which opens when clicked.
attribute_detail.presentation_theme: Which theme a presentation is shown with.
attribute_detail.slide_background: The background of a slide, as a colour or as a CSS gradient.
attribute_detail.tab_width: How many spaces wide one level of indentation is in this code note.
attribute_detail.indent_with_tabs: Indents this code note with tabs rather than spaces.
attribute_detail.wrap_lines: Wraps long lines in this code note instead of scrolling sideways.
attribute_detail.internal_bookmark: A place inside the note that can be linked to directly. Kept up to date by Trilium.
attribute_detail.internal_link: A link from this note to another, kept up to date by Trilium so that backlinks and the note map can be drawn.
attribute_detail.image_link: An image embedded in this note, kept up to date by Trilium.
attribute_detail.relation_map_link: A note placed on this relation map, kept up to date by Trilium.
attribute_detail.include_note_link: A note included into this one's content, kept up to date by Trilium.
attribute_detail.date_template: Set on a calendar root: the note it points at is applied as ~template to each day note generated under it.
attribute_detail.week_template: Set on a calendar root: the note it points at is applied as ~template to each week note generated under it.
attribute_detail.month_template: Set on a calendar root: the note it points at is applied as ~template to each month note generated under it.
attribute_detail.quarter_template: Set on a calendar root: the note it points at is applied as ~template to each quarter note generated under it.
attribute_detail.year_template: Set on a calendar root: the note it points at is applied as ~template to each year note generated under it.
attribute_detail.search_script: Runs a backend script to produce the results of this saved search, instead of evaluating #searchString. The script returns an array of note IDs.
attribute_detail.ancestor: Restricts a saved search to the subtree of the note it points at.
attribute_detail.target: The note a launcher opens when it is pressed.
attribute_detail.script: The script a launcher runs when it is pressed.
attribute_detail.hoisted_note: The note to hoist to when a launcher opens its target.
attribute_detail.share_logo: An image note used as the logo of the shared page. It has to sit inside the shared subtree.
attribute_detail.share_open_graph_image_relation: An image note served as the og:image of the shared page. Set the label of the same name instead to point at an address.

sidebar_help.attributes_what: The labels and relations set on this note itself. A label tags the note with a name and, if you like, a value; a relation points it at another note.
sidebar_help.attributes_inheritable: Marking one inheritable passes it down the whole subtree under the note, where it is listed as inherited rather than owned.
sidebar_help.attributes_inherited_what: Labels and relations reaching this note from elsewhere: an inheritable one set on a note above it, or one carried in by a template.
sidebar_help.attributes_inherited_source: They are read-only here. Each row names the note it comes from, which is where it can be changed or removed.
sidebar_help.attributes_definitions_what: A definition is the schema behind an attribute name: what kind of value it takes, whether it may be given more than once, and whether it is promoted.
sidebar_help.attributes_definitions_promoted: A promoted attribute is shown on the note itself as a form field rather than being left to this panel. Definitions usually arrive from a template, and each row names the note it lives on.
sidebar_help.highlights_what: The passages this note picks out by their formatting. That is a wider net than it sounds: an ordinary bold or italic sentence counts, not only text you have highlighted.
sidebar_help.highlights_configure: Which formats count is yours to set: bold, italic, underlined, coloured text and text on a background colour can each be listed or left out, from the gear in this card's header. Pressing an entry scrolls the note to it.
sidebar_help.note_map_what: A map of what this note connects to. The link map draws the internal links and relations going in and out of it; the tree map draws where it sits in the note tree. The switcher in this header chooses between the two.
sidebar_help.note_map_interaction: Hovering a note brings its own connections forward and fades the rest. The expand button opens the same map at the size of the window.
sidebar_help.note_paths_what: A note can sit in more than one place in the note tree at once, and each of those places is listed here as a path.
sidebar_help.note_paths_cloning: Adding a place is called cloning: nothing is copied, so an edit made under one path shows under all of them, and removing one path leaves the note under the others.
sidebar_help.backlinks_what: The notes pointing at this one, either through a link in their text or through a relation naming it.
sidebar_help.backlinks_listing: A text link is listed with the passage around it, a relation with the name it points by. This side of a link is not editable: it goes away when the note that made it drops the link.
sidebar_help.similar_notes_what: Notes that look related to this one even where nothing links them.
sidebar_help.similar_notes_how: The likeness is worked out from the content of the notes, the attributes and relations they carry, and how close together they were created.

setup.title: Setup

setup.sync-from-desktop-step1: Open your desktop instance of Trilium Notes.
setup.sync-from-desktop-step2: From the Trilium Menu, click Options.
setup.sync-from-desktop-step3: Click on Sync category in the note tree.
setup.sync-from-desktop-step4: Change server instance address to point to one of the addresses on the right and click Save.
setup.sync-from-desktop-step5: Click the "Test sync" button to verify connection is successful.
setup.sync-from-desktop-warning: Make sure both devices are on the same network.
setup.sync-from-desktop-unreachable-title: This device can't be reached by other devices
setup.sync-from-desktop-unreachable-descriptio: To sync, the other desktop has to connect to this one over the network. For security, this desktop app only accepts connections from this computer, so that other desktop can't reach it yet. Allow network access below — Trilium will restart to apply it.
setup.sync-failed-description: The initial synchronization could not be completed. You can retry, or go back to check the server address and credentials.
setup.sync-failed-hint: This can be caused by a wrong server address, a proxy interfering with the connection, or the server being temporarily unreachable.
setup.proxy-instruction: If you leave proxy setting blank, system proxy will be used.
